reason: A cross-platform Electron desktop wrapper for DeepSeek Harness that manages a local agent service, workspaces, plugins, files, and application updates.

summaries.zh: 一个跨平台 Electron 桌面应用，用于运行 DeepSeek Harness、本地管理工作区和插件，并打开相关文件。
summaries.en: A cross-platform Electron desktop app for running DeepSeek Harness, managing local workspaces and plugins, and opening related files.

capabilities: Runs a local DeepSeek Harness service
Installs plugins from npm and GitHub repositories
Executes Harness and plugin code with granted local permissions
Reads and modifies selected workspace files
Opens files and directories in local applications
Downloads and verifies application and runtime updates
